The '''Redrish family''' was an influential [[Human/Legends|Human]] family in the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] that included [[Thelonia Redrish]], who left her privileged life during the [[Great Galactic War]] to assist in relief efforts and eventually led a resistance to take back the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]].
